content: Tařaɣit n Arebbi x Abram
Inna SIDI i Abram: “Ffeɣ zi temmurt nnec, zi temmurt mani dd-txeřqed u zi taddart n babac, ruḥ ɣar temmurt i d ac ɣa ssecneɣ.
Ad zzayek dd-ssuffɣeɣ ijj n řgens imɣar, ad cek barkeɣ u ad ssemɣareɣ isem nnec uca iři d cek ɛawed d lbaraka.
Ad barkeɣ wenni cek i ɣa ibarken d wenni cek i ɣa ineɛřen, ad t neɛřeɣ. Dayek i ɣa ttwabarkent marra řaǧat n temmurt.” *
Uca iruḥ Abram am mammec d as inna SIDI, uca iruḥ Lut akides. Tuɣa Abram ɣares xemsa u-sebɛin n iseggʷusa umi dd-iffeɣ zi Ḥaran.

Uca indeh Abram Saray tamɣart nnes, d Luṭ mmis n umas, d marra agřa i yarebḥen, d iwdan d řmař nni dd-kesben di Ḥaran. Ffɣen zi Ḥaran ḥima ad raḥen ɣar temmurt n Kenɛan uca iwḍen ɣar temmurt n Kenɛan.
Iẓwa Abram zi temmurt nni ɣar wemcan n Cakim ař tacejjart n yigg n Mura. Di řweqt nni tuɣa ayt n Kenɛan zeddɣen di temmurt.
Iban-dd SIDI i Abram, inna as: “I zzariɛet nnec umi i ɣa wceɣ tammurt-a.” Uca ibna din ijj n uɛalṭar min xef issars taɣarṣt i SIDI, wenni d as dd-ibanen.
Xenni iɛdu ssenni ɣar idurar i iǧan x ccarq n Bayt-Il uca iwta dinni iqiḍan nnes, ijja Bayt-Il x jjihet n řɣarb u Ɛay x ccarq. Din ibna ijj n uɛalṭar i SIDI uca iřaɣa Isem n SIDI.
Awarni man aya ifsi Abram iqiḍan nnes, immuṭṭi zeg wemcan ɣar wemcan, ɣar Temmurt n Ljanub.
Abram di Miṣra
Idweř řaẓ di temmurt uca ikemmeř Abram x webrid nnes, ihwa ɣar Miṣra, ḥima ad izdeɣ din am ubarrani, minzi tuɣa řaẓ imɣar di temmurt.
Řami dd-tiweḍ řweqt nni umi i ɣa yudef ɣar Miṣra, inna i Saray, tamɣart nnes: “Xzar, aqa ssneɣ belli cem d tamɣart dayes aẓri.
Xmi cem i ɣa ẓaren Imiṣriyyen, zemmaren ad inin: ‘Ta d tamɣart nnes!’, ad ayi nɣen uca ad cem jjen di tudart.
Ini, aqa cem d učma, ḥima ad ayi yiři řxir di ṭṭweɛ nnem uca ad iqqim řeɛmar inu iddar i cem.”
Imsar umi yudef Abram ɣar Miṣra, ẓrin Imiṣriyyen belli tamɣart teṣbeḥ aṭṭas.
Uřa d řḥukkam n firɛun, ajeǧid, ẓrin tt uca ssemɣaren tt ɣar Firɛun uca iwyen tt ɣar taddart n firɛun.
Uca imṣuref Firɛun mlih ak-d Abram di ṭṭweɛ nnes. Ammu i iksi uǧi d ifunasen d tfunasin d yeɣyař d isemɣan d tiyya d teɣyař d iřeɣman.
Maca SIDI iwta firɛun d aytbab n taddart nnes s jjrayeḥ mɣarent di řesbab n Saray, tamɣart n Abram.
Xenni firɛun iřaɣa-dd i Abram, inna as: “Manawaya i dayi teggid? Maɣar war d ayi tennid belli nettat d tamɣart nnec?
Mayemmi tennid: ‘Nettat d učma!’, ařami tt ggiɣ necc d tamɣart i yixef inu? Řexxu xzar, aqa ac tamɣart nnec, ksi tt, tbeɛɛded!”
Yumur firɛun iryazen nnes xas uca ssqebbḍen t ak-d temɣart nnes u ak-d marra min tuɣa ɣares.

footnotes.text: Cakim- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘taɣruḍt’ niɣ ‘aɛrur’. tacejjart n yigg- niɣ ‘ibejji’. Isem nnes s tlatinit ‘Pistacia Terebintus’, xzar Amawal Amecṭuḥ n Omar Kerdja (424, 437).
Bayt-Il- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘taddart n Arebbi’. Ɛay- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘řxarbet’.
iřeɣman- iřeɣman di Israil u di temmura nneɣni di Ccarq Ameřwasu d iřeɣman s yijj n tgeɛrurt waha.
